name: dsh-python-env
description: DeepSeek Harness plugin: workspace-scoped Python virtual environment management for agents (pyenv_discover / pyenv_create / pyenv_install / pyenv_remove). Runs the standard library python -m venv / pip through the platform subprocess channel instead of the sandboxed shell, so venv creation, pip bootstrapping, and package-index network access work on Windows/macOS/Linux. Every mutation stays inside the session workspace (venvs plus a .dsh-pyenv cache), the global Python environment is never touched, network failures fall back across PyPI mirrors and common local proxy ports, and no third-party environment manager (uv, virtualenv, ...) is required.
